item.title: RC Car in AR
item.description:
Role: idea, code, design and marketing, alone. 2020-2021.

My first Unity project, and my own product. Two months from the first Unity commit to the App Store and Google Play: v1.0 shipped on 2021-01-09.

  • All code: AR Foundation, my own car physics, human occlusion, 3D audio.
  • Localization into 9 languages with my own framework.
  • In-app purchases and ads through Unity Services.
  • Promo videos, ad campaigns and forum posts.
  • 59 commits, about 4k lines of my C#; releases 1.0 to 1.4 in January-May 2021.
